Marcus VanceProduct Lead

Building a product is hard; getting users through your onboarding flow without losing 80% of them along the way is even harder.

Photo Proof Against Buddy Punching breaks down complex multi-step user flows into quantifiable stages, highlighting the precise drop-off points where friction occurs.

The Standard SaaS Signup Funnel#

Most software applications share a core four-step conversion trajectory:

  1. Landing Page Visit (/)
  2. Registration Start (/register)
  3. Workspace Configuration (/onboarding/setup)
  4. Subscription Checkout (/pricing -> checkout.stripe.com)
Industry Average Drop-Off
64.2%Between step 2 & 3

The average proportion of users who abandon signup when email verification or credit card input is requested upfront.

Diagnosing Funnel Leaks with Custom Events#

To identify where users hesitate, define granular custom event steps using the ClockTime tracking API:

Eliminate Unnecessary Form Fields
Every additional input field in your signup form reduces conversion by an average of 4.2%. Remove phone number and company size fields unless strictly required.

Funnel Optimization Checklist#

Before redesigning your product UI, apply these high-impact optimizations:

✓Social Authentication: Add Google and GitHub OAuth to eliminate password creation friction.
✓Deferred Payment Details: Offer 14-day full access trials without requiring upfront credit card details.
✓In-App Checklist: Guide newly registered users to their first "Aha!" moment within 60 seconds of onboarding.
